title: Halfway back
instructions: The hallway is a different length every time you press Run. Drive to the circle at the end, then back up to the X, which is exactly halfway back.
note: If you get stuck, Serial.println(steps); shows what your variable holds.
hint: Add 1 to steps each time the while loop drives a cell, then back up steps / 2. With whole numbers, / throws away any remainder (7 / 2 is 3), and % gives just the remainder (7 % 2 is 1).
